labels.anomaly: fault intervals OR simulated 10-point transient sensor excursion
labels.score_truth: state anchors [96,68,16] + independent Gaussian noise sd 2.2, clipped 0..100

models.selector: project MSF-MOFS grouped Fisher-seeded NSGA-II adaptation, population=8, generations=3 each for stages 1,2
models.classifier: hierarchical logistic regression with separate calibration
models.anomaly: supervised RandomForest on raw 32x8 windows; 120 trees
models.mapping: ordered constrained least-squares fit to simulated operator scores

prohibited: No test data in model fit or parameter tuning
Do not alter simulator/seed for favourable reported scores after test
Models are not a verified safety-critical satellite diagnostic tool
